Sona, which helps companies with workforce management, raised a $45 million Series B led by N47, co-founders Steffen Wulff Petersen and Ben Dixon tell Axios Pro exclusively.

**Why it matters:** Industries like hospitality and retail rely on hourly workers, and more accurate staffing can mean large savings on labor costs.
